uncited: It builds on [Stream Lines](4796-stream-lines.md) by adding temporal visual cues to static geometric trajectories.
- A set of streamlines, defined as sequences of vertices $V = \{v_0, v_1, \dots, v_n\}$.
- **Texture Map:** A static 1D image downloaded to GPU memory once.
**Assign Texture Coordinates:** For each vertex $v_i$ in a streamline, compute the local texture coordinate $u_i$ based on its position along the line segment.
**Render:** Render the lines using the shifted texture coordinates.
- **Time Complexity:** $O(N)$ per frame, where $N$ is the total number of vertices across all streamlines.
- **Memory Complexity:** $O(N)$ for storing vertex positions and texture coordinates.
It is used in scientific visualization to enhance the readability of vector fields in dynamic environments.
